legacy_projection.route_title: Optimization of SiO2-over-TiO2 Two-Layer AR Stack
legacy_projection.compilation_rationale: Resolved contradiction by prioritizing the explicit topology override (6 alternating pairs = 12 finite layers) over the conflicting 'one layer' statement. The stack is fixed as Air | (SiO2/TiO2)x6 | Glass. Optimization targets mean s-polarized reflectance minimization in the 450-700 nm band with a soft preference for <0.03.
